ActivateConnection.description_en: Activates an identity binding. After you click the authorization link in the Connection status to complete the OAuth authorization flow, the development platform activates the current identity binding. Third-party code hosting platforms that use OAuth authorization include GitHub, Gitee, and Codeup
ActivateConnection.description_zh: 激活一个身份绑定。点击Connection状态中的授权链接完成OAuth授权流程后，开发平台会激活当前身份绑定。 使用OAuth授权的第三方代码托管平台包括：GitHub、Gitee、Codeup

CancelPipeline.description_en: Cancels a pipeline execution. The pipeline and its tasks are canceled as soon as possible
CancelPipeline.description_zh: 取消流水线执行。流水线以及任务将被尽快取消执行

CancelTask.description_en: Cancels the execution of a pipeline task

CreateEnvironment.description_en: Creates an environment in a project and optionally deploys the environment automatically based on a template. Services are deployed to a specified environment. An environment can be associated with a branch of a code repository or a project template. An environment can also have an infrastructure stack that is shared by all services in the environment
CreateEnvironment.description_zh:
创建项目下的环境，并可选地根据模板自动部署该环境。
服务会部署到指定的环境中，环境可以绑定代码仓库的某个分支或者某个项目模板。环境还可以设置基础设施堆栈，被环境下的所有服务所共享

CreatePipeline.description_en: Creates a pipeline execution. The pipeline is executed asynchronously and generates specific pipeline tasks based on the configuration
CreatePipeline.description_zh: 创建流水线执行。流水线将被异步地执行，并按照配置，产生具体的流水线任务

CreateProject.description_en: Creates a project and automatically deploys it when a template configuration is specified
CreateProject.description_zh: 创建项目，并在指定模板配置时自动部署此项目

DeleteEnvironment.description_en: Deletes an environment and cascade deletes other entities in the project, including pipeline triggers, pipeline trigger records, pipeline templates, and pipelines
DeleteEnvironment.description_zh: 删除一个环境，并级联删除项目下的其他实体（包括流水线触发器、流水线触发记录、流水线模板、流水线）

DeleteProject.description_en: Deletes a project and cascade deletes other entities under the project, including environments, pipeline triggers, pipeline trigger records, pipeline templates, and pipelines
DeleteProject.description_zh: 删除一个项目，并级联删除项目下的其他实体（包括环境、流水线触发器、流水线触发记录、流水线模板、流水线）

FetchArtifactDownloadUrl.description_en: Retrieves a temporary download URL for the zip package of a deliverable
FetchArtifactDownloadUrl.description_zh: 获取交付物的zip包临时下载地址url

FetchArtifactTempBucketToken.description_en: Retrieves the temporary upload bucket, object, and temporary STS token for a deliverable
FetchArtifactTempBucketToken.description_zh: 获取交付物临时上传的bucket、object和临时sts

FetchConnectionCredential.description_en: Retrieves the identity binding credential that has completed the authorization flow. The development platform uses this credential to access third-party code hosting platforms
FetchConnectionCredential.description_zh: 获取完成授权流程的身份绑定凭证，开发平台会使用该凭证访问第三方代码托管平台

GetRepository.description_en: Queries a repository data binding entity
GetRepository.description_zh: 查询一个仓库绑定实体

GetTask.description_en: Queries the execution of a CI/CD pipeline task

GetToolset.description_en: Retrieves information about a specified toolset
GetToolset.description_zh: 获取某个工具集的信息

ListConnections.description_en: Queries identity bindings that meet the specified conditions in batches
ListConnections.description_zh: 批量查询满足条件的身份绑定

ListEnvironments.description_en: Lists environments that meet the specified conditions
ListEnvironments.description_zh: 批量查询满足条件的环境

ListPipelines.description_en: Lists pipeline executions in batches. Provide as many query conditions as possible to narrow the query scope
ListPipelines.description_zh: 批量查询流水线执行。请尽可能提供更多的查询条件以缩小查询范围

ListProjects.description_en: Lists projects that meet the specified conditions
ListProjects.description_zh: 批量查询满足条件的项目

ListServiceDeployments.description_en: Lists service deployment information in batch
ListServiceDeployments.description_zh: 批量查询服务部署信息

ListTasks.description_en: Lists pipeline task executions in batch
ListTasks.description_zh: 批量查询流水线任务执行

PutTaskStatus.description_en: Replaces the execution status of a pipeline task
PutTaskStatus.description_zh: 替换流水线任务执行状态

RenderServicesByTemplate.description_en: Parses the services and variable configurations in a template
RenderServicesByTemplate.description_zh: 解析模板中的服务以及变量配置

ResumeTask.description_en: Resumes the execution of a CI/CD pipeline node

RetryTask.description_en: Retries the execution of a pipeline task

StartTask.description_en: Starts the execution of a pipeline task

UpdateEnvironment.description_en: Modifies an environment and automatically deploys it when template parameters change
UpdateEnvironment.description_zh: 修改环境，并在模板参数变化时自动部署该环境

UpdateProject.description_en: Modifies a project and automatically deploys it when template parameters change
UpdateProject.description_zh: 修改项目，并在模板参数变化时自动部署该项目

UpdateToolset.description_en: Updates the information of a toolset
